title: Parents of baby girl killed at nursery fear unsafe sleeping ‘rife’ in sector across England

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: childcare settings in England will be banned from September from putting babies under 12 months to sleep in anything other than a cot

social_cohesion_impact.evidence: Genevieve’s parents, Katie and John Meehan, have led a campaign with the charity the Lullaby Trust

justice_rights_impact.evidence: Kate Roughley, the nursery’s deputy manager, was jailed for 14 years in 2024 after being found guilty of manslaughter
